text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I missed the Umasta Live stream.
Even though my favorite nail artist was on it, too~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There aren't even any archives, either.
Haaah... what a total buzzkill...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's just been race after race lately, and my brain's totally fried...
I've got zero breathing room, y'know? Such a drag...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they were so exhausted in body and mind that they completely forgot about the livestream they'd been looking forward to...
It might be best to reconsider the race schedule.
